product.name: TerraLite Trail Lantern 500
product.description: The TerraLite Trail Lantern 500 is engineered for rugged outdoor use, offering a bright LED output in a compact, lightweight design. Its 30 cm body houses a 5000 mAh rechargeable battery that delivers up to 20 hours of illumination on low‑mode, with a quick‑charge USB‑C port enabling a full recharge in under an hour. The lantern features a durable ABS shell with a silicone grip, an adjustable brightness dial, and a built‑in hook for easy hanging. Weather‑sealed to 50 m water‑resistance, it remains operational in rain or mist, making it suitable for night hikes, campfires, and emergency kits. The Midnight Black finish blends functionality with a sleek aesthetic, while the integrated USB‑C port ensures compatibility with modern power banks and car chargers.
